# 305business.llc

> Direct business marketplace and venture acquisition studio in Miami, Florida. $0 commission, $0 success fee, and $0 finder's fee; buyers and sellers connect directly. Operated by a Florida LLC (platform only — not a licensed business brokerage).

## Core Offerings
- **Direct Business Marketplace**: Direct South Florida business listing platform with $0 commissions, $0 success fees, and $0 finder's fees ([Home](https://305business.llc/) | [Español](https://305business.llc/es.html)).
- **Venture Studio Portfolio (26 Assets)**: Acquire software products and operating ventures outright (1x payment) or on an 18-month lease-to-own plan with maintenance included across healthcare AI, sports science, computer vision, and data intelligence ([Venture Portfolio](https://305business.llc/ventures/)).
- **Seller & Valuation Tools**:
  - [List a Business](https://305business.llc/list-business.html)
  - [Business Valuation Request](https://305business.llc/valuation.html)
  - [Pitch Decks](https://305business.llc/pitch-decks.html)
  - [Financial Forecasting](https://305business.llc/financial-forecasting.html)
  - [Mutual NDA & Legal Support Resources](https://305business.llc/legal-support.html)
  - [Broker Portal](https://305business.llc/broker-portal.html)

## Partner Ecosystem
- **AI Dynamics** — Custom AI apps, automation workflows, and bilingual voice receptionists ([aidynamic.pro](https://www.aidynamic.pro) | [Free 15-Minute Triage Call](https://www.aidynamic.pro/booking?service=free_ai_consultation))
- **Medical Billing Miami Beach** — Healthcare revenue cycle management & denial recovery for Florida practices ([medicalbillingmb.com](https://medicalbillingmb.com))
- **PocketScribe (AI Medical Scribe)** — AI clinical documentation ([pocketscribe.online](https://pocketscribe.online/) | [aiscribers.com](https://aiscribers.com))
